skill.name: Commas around extra information
skill.why: Commas hug extra information, so readers can tell it's a bonus detail.
skill.how: Lift it out. If the sentence still means the same thing, put commas around it.

beats.say: Some sentences carry a bonus detail.
Lift it out. The sentence still works.
So the extra part gets a comma on each side.
beats.show: Gus**,** who hates snow**,** went skiing.

beats.say: Miss the second comma and the snow went skiing!
At the end, the full stop does the closing job.
beats.show: We met Gus**,** who hates snow**.**
